BPF loader parameter serialization and deserialization prototypes.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for BPF loader parameter serialization and deserialization in the runtime program. It includes the base Flamenco definitions and VM types, then defines `FD_NON_DUP_MARKER` as a marker value used by the implementation. The file exposes [`fd_bpf_loader_input_serialize_parameters`](<#fd_bpf_loader_input_serialize_parameters>) and [`fd_bpf_loader_input_deserialize_parameters`](<#fd_bpf_loader_input_deserialize_parameters>), which convert instruction context data and VM memory region metadata to and from a serialized input buffer. It uses include guards and `FD_PROTOTYPES_BEGIN` and `FD_PROTOTYPES_END` to control declaration scope.

- `fd_bpf_loader_input_deserialize_parameters`
